profile_text.body:
Teradata Corp /DE/ is a public company, traded under the ticker TDC, with headquarters in San Diego, California. Its site describes it as the AI platform for the autonomous era, connecting and scaling across any environment. The company presents its Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform as a way to make AI real, trusted, governed, and built to scale, and it points to a portfolio of products and services for AI, analytics, and cloud work. It also says it partners with other providers to supply technology, AI-driven resources, and knowledge.

The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0000816761 and is a for-profit entity. Its legal exposure record lists 281 matters in California.
